content: Hey love, how was your day? I couldn't stop thinking about our future together.
Hi, it was okay. Work was stressful, but talking to you always makes it better.
You always make my day brighter too. By the way, I found this incredible place for us, it's exactly what we talked about: big kitchen, close to the park, and tons of sunlight.
That sounds amazing! I can't believe you found somewhere so perfect already.
I know, right? I went for a virtual tour and just pictured us there, cooking dinner together and having quiet nights. It's honestly a dream come true.
Wow, it really does sound like a dream. Is it in our budget?
Yes! It's a great deal for the area. The agent told me there's already a ton of interest though, so we'd need to secure it fast.
Oh, I see. How fast are we talking?
They need a deposit by tonight to hold it for us. I tried explaining we're serious, but they're giving us just a few hours before offering it to someone else.
That's really soon. How much is the deposit?
It's $2,000. I know it's a lot, but this is our chance. I can send you the payment details, the agent only accepts Zelle for the deposit.
Wow, okay. Can I see the payment info and maybe double-check the details first?
Absolutely, I totally get it. Here's the Zelle handle: morrishomes2024@gmail.com. The agent's been really responsive, and I checked their reviews, they're legit. We just have to move fast.
It still feels a little rushed, but I trust you. Are you sure it's safe?
Of course, babe. I wouldn't let anything bad happen to us. I already spoke to the agent this morning and even saw their business license. Our future matters to me.
Alright. I'll start the transfer. Can you let me know when they confirm?
Definitely. As soon as it goes through, I'll call the agent and make sure we get a confirmation. We're really doing this, love!
I just sent it. I hope everything goes smoothly. I'm a little nervous.
You did great, sweetheart. I'll handle everything from here. Just think, soon we'll have a place to call our own.
